limitations: Original holdout was already used in earlier model development; this is not external validation.
Unweighted participant split; NHANES survey design and household/PSU clustering are not modeled.
Cross-sectional CAP prediction is not a diagnosis or a causal prediction of dietary response.
Eligible complete exams include ages 12 through 80 (age may be top-coded).
Bootstrap interval conditions on the fitted models and does not include tuning uncertainty.
Repeated development on the same cohort adds selection optimism; external validation remains necessary.
Expanded models require additional measurements; they are not drop-in replacements for the 14-input model.
LBXTR is a fasting subsample measurement with substantial missingness; use only appropriate reference-assay inputs.
